description: Use this when the user asks whether inbound email is ready or needs setup. Returns domains, routes, deployed Functions, and recent inbound activity. Adding or verifying a domain is done with the domain management tools, which are served at /mcp/full.

api_key.description: Primitive API key (prim_...). Only needed when this connection has no signed-in account: pass the api_key returned by createEmailAddress, unchanged, on every call for the rest of the conversation. Omit it when the user is signed in.
